invalidated_evidence: Excluded from the repository; reasons are recorded in timing_caveats.

odoo19_py314.reason: Official pinned Odoo requirements select libsass==0.22.0, whose build backend is incompatible with CPython 3.14.

odoo_master_py314.reason: Official pinned Odoo requirements select libsass==0.22.0, whose build backend is incompatible with CPython 3.14.

timing_caveats: Only the compute boundary was executed; ORM extraction, ORM writes, shell, HTTP, end-to-end, and multiprocess Odoo-server performance were not measured.
The steady-state run explicitly set PYROXIDE_MAX_TASKS_PER_WORKER=0. Its Pyroxide maximum was 0.033407167 seconds.
The recycling run explicitly set PYROXIDE_MAX_TASKS_PER_WORKER=100. Synchronous worker replacement produced one 0.303523167-second Pyroxide batch.
Two earlier runs that claimed recycling was disabled actually used the default of 100. They are excluded from the repository and from steady-state conclusions.
